name: Linked sessions
description: Runs of agent teams read as their sessions on one clock: any runs picked or compared side by side, one lane per session with each subagent under the session that spawned it, every tool call a mark coloured by the labels or by any field, filters on every field and on time, and a session's calls beside the lanes with the file they come from.

records.name: call
records.one: one tool call, its tool_use line and its tool_result line

fields.name: time
fields.how: seconds since the run's first line

fields.name: duration
fields.how: seconds between them

fields.name: duration band
fields.how: under 1 s, 1–10 s or over 10 s

fields.name: tool
fields.how: Agent read as Task

fields.name: outcome
fields.from: is_error or isError, and the result's text
fields.how: denied when the text says so, error when flagged, else ok

fields.name: result
fields.how: its first line, a denial's or an error's prefix dropped

fields.name: exit
fields.how: the number after Exit code

fields.name: output
fields.how: the text without its Exit code and agentId lines

fields.name: files
fields.from: file_path, or a Bash command and its result
fields.how: the paths named in them

fields.name: file type
fields.how: the first file's extension, test files apart

fields.name: matches
fields.from: a Grep's toolUseResult filenames, else its result's lines
fields.how: the files a Grep matched

fields.name: child
fields.from: the Task result's agentId, else the prompt a session got
fields.how: the session the Task call spawned

fields.name: again
fields.how: when the same command ran next, with its outcome

records.name: message
records.one: one prompt or text of a session

fields.name: kind
fields.how: prompt, result for a session's last text, else text

records.name: return
records.one: a subagent's last words to the session that spawned it

fields.name: ran
fields.from: the subagent's first and last lines
fields.how: seconds it ran

records.name: session
records.one: one transcript, a lead's or a subagent's

fields.name: agent
fields.from: a Task call's subagent_type, else the run's index
fields.how: the subagent's type, else the index's name, else lead

fields.name: parent
fields.from: the Task call that names its agentId or gave its prompt
fields.how: the session that spawned it

fields.name: depth
fields.how: sessions above it in its run's tree

fields.name: spawn
fields.how: the time of the Task call that spawned it

fields.name: start
fields.how: seconds since the run's first line

fields.name: end
fields.how: seconds since the run's first line

fields.name: waits
fields.from: the Task calls it waited on
fields.how: the spans it waited, overlaps merged

records.name: moment
records.one: what another session of the run was doing at a call's time

fields.name: state
fields.from: the session's times, waits and calls
fields.how: starts, returned, waiting or call

fields.name: started
fields.how: in UTC

fields.name: span
fields.how: seconds from its first line to its last

records.name: compared group
records.one: a run, or a session with its subagents, beside others

fields.name: wall clock
fields.from: its first session's start and end
fields.how: seconds its first session ran

fields.name: summed time
fields.how: the seconds its sessions ran, added up

fields.name: in tool calls
fields.how: its calls' durations added up, Task calls aside

fields.name: waiting
fields.how: seconds it waited on subagents

accepts.means: the line <n>: a call (its tool_use or its tool_result line) or a message shown in its session's transcript, or in a run's index the run

units.means: one run: its sessions, with the view narrowed to it
one session: its lane and its whole transcript
